title: Violet.Cascade.S01E05.2026.1080p.WEB-DL.H264-TESTGRP
description: Two decoder-tolerance probes in one release. The media file carries the encoder's own prose block ahead of the data in every article, continuations included, so a decoder has to skip non-uu lines rather than assume the body starts with the encoding. The sidecar's final group is left unpadded, the way a class of broken encoder posted it. Both must come back byte-identical.
